name: Valkyrie (Sorcerer Bloodline)
body:
The choosers of the slain sometimes take great mortal heroes as lovers or share their powers with worthy warriors. The descendants of valkyriesB3, or spellcasters blessed by a valkyrieB3, become arcane champions of the gods of death and battle.

Class Skill(s)

Knowledge (planes).

Bonus Spells

deathwatch (3rd), aid (5th), gentle repose (7th), death ward (9th), divine power (11th), geas/quest (13th), plane shift (15th), greater summon flying mountBL8 (17th), soul bind (19th).

Bonus Feats

Arcane Armor Training, Defensive Combat Training, Great Fortitude, Light Armor Proficiency, Skill Focus (Intimidate), Spell Focus (abjuration), Toughness, Weapon Focus (spear).

Bloodline Arcana

You master the energies of life and death. The DC to dispel or counter abjuration or necromancy (life) spells that you cast is increased by +4.

Bloodline Powers You have the impulse for glorious fight in your blood, and can also fight for the living against death itself.

Stabilize (Sp)

At 1st level, you can use stabilize as a spell?like ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier. If the affected creature is damaged again within a minute after you used this ability, it doesn’t resume dying.

Valkyrie’s Resistances (Ex)

At 3rd level, you gain resist cold 5 and resist electricity 5. At 9th level, your resistances increase to 10.

Valkyrie’s Wings (Su)

At 9th level, you gain the ability to grow a pair of white feathered wings from your back as a standard action. The wings grant you a fly speed of 60 feet with good maneuverability. You can dismiss the wings as a free action.

Fight Death (Sp)

At 15th level, you can snatch the lives of your allies from death’s grip. Once per day, when an attack or an effect would result in the death of another creature, you can touch that creature as a standard action and heal it as per the breath of life spell.

Envoy of Valhalla (Su)

At 20th level, you become an agent of the powers of death and life. You gain immunity to cold, electricity, and poison. You also gain resist acid 10, resist fire 10, and deathwatch as a constant spell-like ability. Finally, you can cast true resurrection once per day.
